title: PROJECT CHARTER — Austrian MMM & Budget Optimizer (AMBO)
summary: Project charter defining business problem, scope, deliverables with acceptance criteria, milestones, risks, and epistemic rules for an Austrian marketing-mix-model and budget optimizer.
notes: Charter format: goals, in/out-of-scope, deliverables with explicit acceptance criteria, milestones, risk register -> dominant PRD signals. Contains binding governance rules (E-1..E-5) and self-declares highest authority ('Charter beats specs; specs beat code; deviations require ADRs'), which is an ADR-like locking claim but not an ADR document (no Context/Decision/Consequences, no status: Accepted). Synthesizer may want to assign elevated precedence per the document's own authority statement.
